messages:
Nora Kim: Quick micro-iteration: tiny latency tile for dense dashboards. p95 large, mini throughput sparkline under, and a 'Sampling' pill (top-right). Popover opens inline with mode + percent slider. Thoughts on aria and compact copy? :wave:
Ethan Gray: Love compact. Two quick asks: pill must show state (Adaptive / 20%), and throughput needs unit label 'RPS'. Sparkline hover should show exact RPS.
Priya Singh: Accessibility: pill tabbable, aria-expanded + aria-controls. Popover role=\"dialog\" and announce open via live region: \"Sampling settings opened. Currently Adaptive at 20%\". Slider changes announced politely.
Marco Li: Microcopy: use \"Sampling: Adaptive\". Popover title: \"Sampling settings\". If we include an estimated cost line, hide it behind an opt-in toggle inside the popover.
DesignBot: auto-lint: contrast-warning for pill text at current token; suggest using text-strong token or bolder weight.
